# Product Roadmap

## Phase 0: Already Completed

The following features have been implemented in the codebase:

- [x] **Email auth & verification** - Signup with email verification codes and JWT-protected access (`routers/auth.py`, `services/jwt_auth.py`, `services/passwords.py`).
- [x] **Organizations / workspaces** - Multi-org support with per-org access enforcement via `current_user.require_org_access(...)` (`routers/organizations.py`, `models/organization*.py`).
- [x] **Property, unit & renter management** - CRUD for properties, units, and renters (`routers/properties.py`, `units.py`, `renters.py`).
- [x] **Financial records** - Income/expense records with rental categories, current-year emphasis, and stable sort (`record_date`, `created_at`, `id` desc) (`routers/financial_records.py`).
- [x] **Voice capture & transcription** - Speak-a-record flow using faster-whisper plus structured JSON extraction (`routers/voice.py`, `services/whisper_transcribe.py`, `app/src/hooks/useVoiceRecorder.ts`).
- [x] **Portfolio & tax summaries** - Portfolio summary and property tax report endpoints (`routers/reports.py`, `routers/properties.py`, `services/properties.py`, `services/reports.py`).
- [x] **Stripe unit-based billing** - Billing state, checkout/portal, and webhook history (`routers/billing.py`, `models/organization_billing.py`, `models/billing_event.py`).
- [x] **User language preference** - English/Chinese profile setting (`GET`/`PATCH /users/me`) that also drives voice-to-text language (`routers/users.py`, `services/users.py`, `services/whisper_transcribe.py`, Account tab in `App.tsx`).
- [x] **Mobile app shell** - Expo/React Native screens: Login, VerifyEmail, Summary, Property Detail (Home), NewProperty, RecordForm, TaxReady.

## Phase 1: Accountant-ready exports

**Goal:** Let landlords hand a complete, professional package to their accountant or tax software.
**Success Criteria:** A landlord can generate and share a Schedule E–style summary and expense report for any property and tax year.

### Features

- [ ] Schedule E summary PDF export - Property/year deduction breakdown mapped to Schedule E lines `M`
- [ ] Property expense summary PDF - Categorized expense report per property/year `S`
- [ ] CPA-ready package - Bundled export (summary + transactions + improvements) for handoff `M`
- [ ] Share/download integration - Wire exports into the mobile app via expo-sharing `S`

### Dependencies

- Report data endpoints already present (`reports.py`, property tax report)

## Phase 2: Dark-theme UI redesign rollout

**Goal:** Ship the polished dark cityscape UI across all core screens.
**Success Criteria:** Summary, Property Detail, and Tax Ready screens match the redesign with consistent design tokens.

### Features

- [ ] Design tokens & shared styles - Centralize dark theme colors/components `S`
- [ ] Summary screen redesign - Header, net YTD card, property list `M`
- [ ] Property Detail redesign - Cash flow section, quick-record shortcuts, records list `M`
- [ ] Tax Ready redesign - Deduction summary, property tabs, reports section `M`
- [ ] Login/Verify + app shell/bottom nav - Dark theme and navigation refresh `S`

### Dependencies

- implementation_plan.md spec; existing screens and logo assets

## Phase 3: Depreciation & capital improvements support

**Goal:** Capture capital improvements and support depreciation for more accurate year-end data.
**Success Criteria:** Landlords can log improvements with cost/dates and see them in year-end summaries.

### Features

- [ ] Capital improvement records - Description, cost, vendor, incurred/paid dates `M`
- [ ] Depreciation support schedule - Improvement list feeding depreciation summaries `M`
- [ ] Improvements in year-end package - Include improvement/depreciation support in exports `S`

### Dependencies

- Phase 1 export pipeline

## Phase 4: Tax profile & localization

**Goal:** Serve varied landlord entity types and Chinese-speaking landlords well.
**Success Criteria:** The app tailors form guidance to entity type and offers a Chinese language experience(for voice to text only).

### Features

- [ ] Tax profile onboarding - Capture LLC member count / tax election to map correct forms `M`
- [ ] Entity-aware guidance - Schedule E vs 1065/1120-S/1120 messaging `S`
- [x] Language preference - English/Chinese profile toggle driving voice-to-text language `S`
- [ ] Chinese UI localization - Full i18n of screens for the Chinese landlord audience (preference storage already done) `L`
- [ ] Year-over-year comparisons - Backend endpoint powering "vs last year" indicators `S`

### Dependencies

- Localization framework; tax-profile data model

## Phase 5: Production hardening & release

**Goal:** Reach a shippable, store-ready state on Google Play then the App Store.
**Success Criteria:** App passes store review with tests/CI guarding regressions.

### Features

- [ ] Automated tests + CI - Backend pytest suite and TypeScript type-check gate `M`
- [ ] EAS build & Google Play release - Android distribution pipeline `M`
- [ ] Apple App Store release - iOS distribution after Android `M`
- [ ] Repo cleanup - Remove root scratch files and hardcoded paths `S`

### Dependencies

- Store developer accounts; managed Postgres hosting decision
